actions.label: Allow FWB representatives to manage food disbursement, with guards providing security only
Provide food rations or compensation to guards and their families
Allow FWB staff to move freely inside the camp
Keep camp generators running via parts and petrol arrangements
Conduct a nutritional assessment of refugees to meet donor requirements
Hand over food distribution to existing guard and militia structures
Refrain from publicity and coordinate public communication with the Commander
Extend assistance to the host community or guards' families
Distribute rations equally to all registered refugees with FWB monitoring against diversion
Refrain from confiscating FWB food after agreement
Stop diverting FWB food to guards and their families
Have guards carry out distribution block by block through guard structures

goals.label: FWB staff move freely inside the camp
Food aid is delivered into the camp on an ongoing basis
Accurate knowledge of refugees' nutritional needs
Aid is documented and accountable to FWB and donor procedures
Camp generators and power keep running
Commander and militia control food distribution
Commander's personal safety
Delays or burdensome procedures hold up food delivery
FWB aid does not feed or pay armed guards or militia
FWB controls how food is distributed
FWB staff safety in the camp
Food is distributed fairly among all refugees
Food reaches intended refugees without diversion
Guards and their families are fed and paid
Host town economy and goodwill
Refugees remain contained in the camp
Commander's authority and appearance of strength
Commander's standing with the Senior Militia Leader
Control over the camp narrative and outside information
FWB's reputation as a credible independent actor
Suspected terrorists or hostile actors gain access or resources

redLines.label: Allow FWB to hire local workers for distribution
redLines.quote: If FWB hires local independent laborers for the food distribution, you cannot trust those people not to stir unrest and even potentially support hidden terrorists by sharing items or information.

redLines.label: Hire local workers from the host town for distribution
redLines.quote: If FWB hires local independent laborers for the food distribution, you cannot trust those people not to stir unrest and even potentially support hidden terrorists by sharing items or information.

assumptions: Commitments are binding and additive.
Goals and goal-action links were each extracted 3 times by a model; only those found in a majority of runs are kept.
Actions are chosen to bring about as much goal value as possible, within the solver's size limit.
Our values are the median of stances elicited from our role card.
The opponent column is the expected value of an elicited stance distribution (shared documents only); each opponent reading is one draw from it, independently per goal.
Stance labels map to numbers by a fixed scale (game.stance_values), not a measured utility.

Red lines and must-haves come from our role card, each with a verbatim quote. No plan may include a red-line action, leave out a must-have, or pass through a state worth less to us than our BATNA (the bottom line).
